bullets.text: Designed a Python-based multi-agent NLP MLOps pipeline that turns raw reviews into structured JSON: review-type classification, per-topic sentiment, supporting evidence quotes and staff-name linking, feeding dashboards for client reporting (contributing to a 20% lift in client retention).

Cut inference costs using a Python-based two-tier routing architecture: urgent single reviews go to the Gemini API for low-latency responses, while large batch jobs run on a self-hosted Gemma 27B model on company GPU hardware, lowering per-review operational costs.

Raised subcategory recall from 0.78 to 0.96 (F1 0.98), measured on a 500-review golden set of hard cases, then locked in gains using an MLOps regression suite that re-runs the set on every Python code change and fails the build if accuracy drops.
Adopted by account managers using the Python platform to prepare for client meetings: per-dealer breakdowns show where a dealership is struggling before walking in, sharpening renewal conversations.
